task.builtin.project-qa.name: Project Q&A
task.builtin.project-qa.description: Ask questions about project documents and research memory, with answers grounded in the project context.
task.builtin.project-qa.prompt: Answer my question using the project documents and research memory, and explain the evidence behind your conclusions.
task.builtin.literatures-briefs.name: Literature review
task.builtin.literatures-briefs.descript: Synthesize the research background, key ideas, contradictions, and gaps in project documents.
task.builtin.literatures-briefs.prompt: Write a literature review based on the project documents, covering key ideas, evidence, disagreements, and research gaps.
task.builtin.core-ideas.name: Extract core ideas
task.builtin.core-ideas.description: Identify core ideas, supporting evidence, and follow-up questions in project materials.
task.builtin.core-ideas.prompt: List the core ideas in the project documents and explain the main evidence for each.
task.builtin.research-gaps.name: Discover research gaps
task.builtin.research-gaps.description: Find unresolved questions, evidence gaps, and potential research topics in project documents.
task.builtin.research-gaps.prompt: Identify research gaps, contradictions, and testable questions in the project documents.
task.builtin.hypothesis-generator.name: Generate research hypotheses
task.builtin.hypothesis-generator.descri: Turn findings and gaps into testable hypotheses, separating observed evidence, inference, and unknowns.
task.builtin.hypothesis-generator.prompt: Propose testable research hypotheses based on the project documents. Separate observed evidence, inference, missing variables, and validation plans; do not infer statistical significance from repeat experiments or successful antibody validation from antibody generation.
task.builtin.experiment-design.name: Experiment design suggestions
task.builtin.experiment-design.descripti: Develop ideas for variables, controls, data collection, and validation around project hypotheses or questions.
task.builtin.experiment-design.prompt: Design an actionable experiment based on the project documents, including variables, controls, data, and validation criteria.
